purpose: Precommitted descriptive clean/noisy baseline before any denoiser comparison. Objective metrics are auxiliary and cannot authorize treatment.

si_sdr.definition: Scale-Invariant Signal-to-Distortion Ratio using zero-mean reference and estimate, orthogonal projection of estimate onto reference, and 10*log10(projected_energy/error_energy).
si_sdr.reference: Le Roux et al., SDR -- Half-Baked or Well Done?, ICASSP 2019, DOI 10.1109/ICASSP.2019.8683855

stoi.reference: Taal et al., An Algorithm for Intelligibility Prediction of Time-Frequency Weighted Noisy Speech, IEEE TASL 2011, DOI 10.1109/TASL.2011.2114881
stoi.resampling: pystoi internal processing as defined by its classic STOI implementation

pesq.reason: Not part of this baseline: ITU-T P.862 was withdrawn/deleted in 2024 and reference-software licensing is unsuitable as a default project evaluation dependency.
